_comment: Copy or merge this into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). The installer does this idempotently via python3 json.dump.

PostToolUse._comment: Suggest a UI validation run after editing user-facing files.
PostToolUse.command: printf '\033[33m[ui-kit]\033[0m UI file changed. Consider: "validate the affected screen with ui-validation"\n' >&2
